newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: DEBT IN HARD CURRENCY FALLS IN FEB.
newsitem.headline: DEBT IN HARD CURRENCY FALLS IN FEB.

text.p: Lithuania's state debt in hard currencies as of March 1 was $1.163 billion compared with debt of $1.175 billion on February 1, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.
Loans taken in the name of the state came to $879.5 million and loans taken with a government guarantee were $283.2 million, the ministry said in a statement.

By March 1, the government signed loan agreements worth $1.975 billion, including state loans worth $1.364 billion and loans with a government guarantee worth $611.5 million. These agreements have been signed but not all of them used.
The statement also said that the state has used $1.378 billion of loans and of that the state has taken $990.4 million and with a state guarantee $387.8 million.
